incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — PROD: Quality regression detected for tenant 'AcmeCorp' (tenant-id t-acm-42) on Dedicated Pool dp-us-west-2-3. Metric: eval-quality-drop > 18% over last 10m after config rollout. Candidate cause: quantization profile "q8_fast" applied to model 'redwood-7b-v3'. Paging on-call SRE and ML runbook.
emma_sre: ack — I'm oncall, pinging ML and runtime leads. pulling logs now.
jamie_ml: thanks — saw a spike of low-precision tokens in the eval stream. reproducing locally with the q8 profile on a copy of the model. initial hypothesis: quantization clipping on some attention kernels.
nikhil_platform: noted impact: single tenant on dedicated pool (no cross-tenant blast radius) but customer-facing latency and hallucination complaints. CS flagged a live user complaining about incorrect PII redaction.
sam_csm: I've DM'd Acme CSM and prepared holding message: "We're investigating a model quality issue affecting a small subset of responses. We're working on a fix and will follow up within 30 minutes." They asked for ETA and whether we can revert.
emma_sre: quick status: CPU/GPU health stable, no infra scale event. Errors are in model outputs. Observability: per-tenant eval scores dropped from 0.92 -> 0.72.
jamie_ml: reproduce steps I used:
```
# reproduce snippet
python reproduce.py --model redwood-7b-v3 --quant-profile q8_fast --tenant t-acm-42 --seed 42
```
local runs show same drop. Profiling shows large increases in softmax approximation error on layers 10-12.
emma_sre: we need a mitigation plan. Options: 1) revert quantization profile for this tenant only 2) pin tenant to previous model binary 3) fallback routing to hosted variant. Thoughts?
jamie_ml: recommend tenant-scoped revert of quant profile to "q8_safe" (previous baseline) — fastest. I can prepare a config change and a canary in ~8-12m.
nikhil_platform: we have a tenant-scoped config layer. Steps to patch:
1) create a per-tenant config override
2) trigger model worker rolling restart for that tenant's pods
3) monitor eval and logs
I'll script this but need runtime lead to approve rolling kill window.
alex_runtime: I can perform the rolling restart. Plan: 3 worker pods in pool -> restart sequentially with health checks. Target RTO < 15m.
jamie_ml: config to apply (dev-proposed):
```json
{"tenant_overrides": {"t-acm-42": {"quant_profile": "q8_safe"}}}
```
I'll push a patch to the config service and verify.
emma_sre: go for it. Also record for postmortem: why regional dedicated rollout applied q8_fast to pool; need a canary gating.
deploy-bot: deploy 2050001235 initiated by jamie_ml: config-service.patch -> override/t-acm-42/quant_profile=q8_safe
emma_sre: starting the rolling restart now (pod restarts will be staggered 30s apart). tagging on-call rotation: @nikhil_platform you're ops on deck for rollback if health degrades.
nikhil_platform: watching. executing script: `./tenant_patch.sh t-acm-42 q8_safe` (reacted with :eyes:)
jamie_ml: patch applied. validating model outputs on canary pod...
emma_sre: canary pod back healthy at 2050001261. Eval score back to 0.91 for sample set.
sam_csm: pinged Acme: told them we started a tenant-specific revert and seeing immediate improvements in canary, will follow up when fully restored. They asked about root cause and whether this could impact other tenants — I said no evidence of cross-tenant impact yet.
alex_runtime: continuing rolling restart: pod-1 -> pod-2 -> pod-3. monitored CPU/GPU usage normal.
jamie_ml: post-change checks: no PII hallucinations in 100 sampled responses. Token-level diff shows reduced softmax variance.
emma_sre: great. full pool back to steady state at 2050001285. final per-tenant eval 0.92.
nikhil_platform: marking incident mitigated. we should keep a watch for 1 hour.
jamie_ml: immediate next actions: revert the fleet-wide promotion of "q8_fast" from the last rollout, add a canary gate requiring per-tenant sanity checks for quantization profiles. filing follow-ups.
emma_sre: oncall handoff in 15m to @nikhil_platform — leaving a short Handoff note in #eng-oncall.
sam_csm: Acme updated: confirmed that recent queries look correct. they asked for a follow-up call; scheduling for tomorrow.
jamie_ml: I'll open a PR with revert + test harness to run our eval set per-tenant before promotion.
nikhil_platform: logging runbook steps and tagging the change IDs: config-patch=2050001235, restart-window=2050001260-2050001285.
emma_sre: incident-bot: closing page as mitigated for now. final note: customer impact limited to single tenant, mitigation was tenant-scoped config override + rolling restarts, root cause suspected quantization profile regression in q8_fast interacting with attention kernels. Postmortem owners: jamie_ml (ML root cause), nikhil_platform (deploy/config), emma_sre (ops/monitoring).
incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated). Severity: SEV3 -> reduced. Follow-up: postmortem requested (72h SLA).
alex_runtime: left a config diff in PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/configs/pull/912 (reacted with :thumbsup:)
jamie_ml: thanks team. I'll draft the postmortem and recommended safety checks for quant profile promotions.
emma_sre: handing off to @nikhil_platform for watch window. I'm available if anything spikes.
nikhil_platform: acknowledged handoff. continuing monitoring. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
sam_csm: closing customer loop briefing scheduled.
